notes.title: SUCRONOMICON DEMO is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2][b]It’s time! Sweet nightmares await, brave bakers! [/b][/h2]

The Sucronomicon Demo is officially live, and we can’t wait for you to try it out. 
Get hands-on with the game, experiment with dark baking magic, and let us know what you think! 

This is your chance to get early access to the madness, provide feedback, and help shape the final version of the game! 
Try the Demo, and don’t forget to wishlist Sucronomicon on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932380/Sucronomicon/ 

Want to see it in action? Our awesome content creators [b]Somnia_Lightfell[/b] and [b]MrSunDragon[/b] will be streaming Sucronomicon, come hang out and get a first look! 

[h3]Somnia_Lightfell[/h3] → https://m.twitch.tv/somnia_lightfell/home
[h3]MrSunDragon[/h3] → https://www.youtube.com/@MrSunDragon/featured 

🔥🔥🔥[b]Thank you for supporting the project, and hope you will all enjoy our game! [/b]🔥🔥🔥
Make sure to wishlist the game and follow us to stay tuned for more project updates!

Happy baking!

[previewyoutube=tlqn2RwSyS0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 🧁 SUCRONOMICON DEMO is coming to the table 🧁
notes.content:
[h2]We’re excited to announce that Sucronomicon Demo is coming [b]April 18, 10 am AST! [/b][/h2]

Get ready to whip up forbidden desserts and fight against the ticking clock in our darkly-delicious baking game. 

It’s been an incredible journey bringing the game to life, and we can’t wait for you to finally get a taste. 
Huge thanks to our amazing community for the support so far. Your enthusiasm means everything! 

To celebrate, some of our awesome content creators will be livestreaming the game on [b]April 18, 8 pm EDT[/b], so be sure to tune in and check it out: 

[h3]Somnia_Lightfell[/h3] → https://m.twitch.tv/somnia_lightfell/home
[h3]MrSunDragon[/h3] → https://www.youtube.com/@MrSunDragon/featured 


[h2]Wishlist now and prepare your ovens, this won’t be a piece of cake! [/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932380/Sucronomicon/ 

🔥🔥🔥[b]Your support at launch would mean everything to us! [/b]🔥🔥🔥

Steam is a competitive kitchen, and every wishlist, review, and share helps us keep the ovens burning. 
We’ve poured our hearts into Sucronomicon, and can’t wait for you to take your first bite. 

See you in the kitchen!
